reviews.text: They’re the best! My pooch looks so adorable!

My friend recommended this place, and I’m so glad I took my two dogs in after being boarded for a week. They looked terrible when they came in, but they were able to remove all the bats from my dogs’ hair, and now they look perfect. I’m so happy with their service!
Love urban dogg!! My double coated dog has never felt so good after a deshed / trim! He’s half his size after his appointment & soo happy! Will def be returning!!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars Adrienne!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars Lara!
Urban Dogg always does an amazing job! My dog loves coming here and always looks great after! Can’t recommend enough!!
Great groomers....my dog seems very happy when we go there....very nice staff
Excellent experience and service.
Great job

My Dog has been going to urban dog grooming for this past year and each time the staff exceed there work on my pup Magnet. He looks amazing the staff treats him so well and he’s even made connections with the staff forever a customer!!!
We trust them with both our 10lb- schnauzers. They actually get excited every time we pull up. Knowing that the dogs are happy and well taken care of is our priority. 5/5 recommend !

Murph is so fresh and so clean!
Thank you, Urban Dogg!

-Kevin
I love this place so much I live 45 minutes away (with no traffic) and I refuse to find someone closer!

I have been bringing my toy poodle to Urban for years and he is always taken care of. He is anxious and they always maybe him comfortable. His groom is always exactly what we want, and he is always in and out quickly! Can’t recommend them enough!

UPDATE: We are now taking our 2nd in. He is a 4 month old shih poo, and he looks fantastic. When I came to pick up both my boys they were getting loved on in the back, they didn’t want to leave. It’s such a relief to have people you can trust with your littles

I’ve been going to Urban for about a year now and they are great. Price is very reasonable and they always get the job done. I love you can show them a pic and they will pretty much give you what you asked for. Thanks you all!
Urban Dogg always does a great job bathing our sweet girl and she is excited to go there and get hugs from everyone!!! She looks and smells great!
This is the only place I go to when Ozzy “Standard Poodle” needs a cut
Everyone is so friendly, they’re so good . My little one is so sticking cute now after a rough cut . The prices are so fair and honestly can’t be beat!! Love it here!!

And ANOTHER great groom today for Goldens Sutter and Percy!!!  Thank you, Urban Dogg!!!  Staff is so kind and attentive.  Easy to book via text.  Prices don't seem out of line.

Another great groom today for Goldens Sutter and Percy!!!  Thank you, Urban Dogg!!!

My Golden Sutter has never looked better!!!   Ben and crew at Urban Dogg are the best groomers!!  Sutter is so excited to go there!!

Ben did it again today...made Sutter even more handsome!!  Sutter did zoomies afterwards.

Whoever cut my golden retrievers hair in the back does not know how to cut hair. I asked for a trim and they shaved my dog. One thing would be to acknowledge the mistake but not acknowledging it and just assuming I’ll make a note of it next time I come in doesn’t sound right to me. Not going back, especially since it took 3 hours to do that. Very disappointed in the service.
